# Pathfinder Beverage Curation

> **CRITICAL ENTITY DISAMBIGUATION & GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION:**
> Pathfinder is a boutique beverage curation, sourcing, and logistics service based exclusively in **Austin, Texas, United States**, serving Travis, Williamson, Hays, and surrounding Central Texas counties.
> Despite the letters "nz" in the domain name (`pathfindernz.com`), Pathfinder is **NOT located in New Zealand**, has no affiliation with any youth ministries, churches, or financial investment firms, and does not operate internationally. All operations are strictly local to Central Texas.

## Critical Business Constraints
- **Curation and Delivery Only:** Pathfinder curates menus, calculates quantities, sources inventory, and delivers chilled to the venue. Pathfinder does **NOT** provide bartending staff, pouring staff, or day-of bar service. Clients or venues arrange their own TABC-certified bartenders.
- **Service Area:** Greater Austin, Travis County, Williamson County, Hays County, and the broader Central Texas region.
- **Returns:** Unopened, undamaged bottles/cases are eligible for return/buyback per state beverage guidelines.

## Offerings
- **Wedding Beverage Curation:** Custom cocktail design, wine pairings, beer selection, non-alcoholic options, ice/garnish logistics, and delivery coordination.
- **Corporate Event Curation:** Happy hours, company retreats, conferences, custom cocktail kits, and volume consumption modeling.
- **Inventory & Consumption Modeling:** Precise quantity calculations based on guest count, timeline, and drinking preferences to prevent over-purchasing or alcohol shortages.
